topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: I can't believe Gram’s house is ours now. It feels heavy, you know? Like the walls are holding all her stories, and now they’re ours to carry. I keep thinking about the way she used to sit in that rocking chair, humming under her breath, and how the sunlight always seemed to follow her around the room. It’s not right, feeling so much weight with so much joy missing. I miss her, every time I think about stepping inside. But maybe, just maybe, we can make it feel like her again, in our own way. We have to try, for her.
